newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq says four children killed by 1991 bomb.
newsitem.headline: Iraq says four children killed by 1991 bomb.

text.p: Four Iraqi children were killed when a bomb dropped by Western forces in 1991 exploded in their village, al-Iraq newspaper reported on Thursday.
The newspaper said the children, aged two to seven years, were killed in Sinna village in the Amarah area 370 km (230 miles) south of Baghdad. Three children were injured.

The bomb was dropped by U.S.-led forces during the 1991 Gulf War to eject Iraqi troops from Kuwait, the newspaper said. Iraqi civil defence units were able to defuse two more bombs near the place where the incident took place, it added.
